rules: standard leaders/Worship; equal turns; half-credit ties for finished games
startup: Uniform integer 0..4; that many distinct uniformly shuffled action piles; same selection for both bots and both seat orientations
policy: Uniform random playable Action instance; play all Treasures in random order; then uniform random choice among each affordable permitted purchase and each legal shared Worship. No voluntary pass while Buys remain and a spending choice exists. Stop spending when Buys are exhausted. Optional choices sample uniformly among all legal target subsets, including empty; mandatory choices obey their minimum.
purchaseRestriction: Drachma, Talent, Acropolis and the shared selected action piles only
effectGains: Normal legal gains, including cards outside purchase whitelist
randomness: Independent decision streams keyed by seed and seat, reused for the seat-swapped partner; no policy tuning or win-rate heuristic
guard: 500 completed turns each or 100000 commands; 14 censored at 500 turns
change: Only random trash choices changed: exclude nonempty subsets leaving whole-deck income capacity below $3, before any replacement gain. Treasures + all nonterminal Action coins + terminal Action coins supported by legal Actions; includes Thaleia nonterminal trigger, excludes conditional reveal bonuses and speculative gains.
incomeExtension: Includes Nereon once when a matching Action is playable; other policy behavior unchanged
